$comment: Traditional-Chinese (Taiwan) speech corpus with a KNOWN ground truth, for real ASR acceptance testing. Kept as UTF-8 data rather than inline in a PowerShell script, because Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads .ps1 files using the system ANSI codepage and would corrupt CJK literals. The generator reads this file with an explicit UTF-8 decode.
note: The ground truth is the text handed to the speech synthesiser. Recognition output is compared against it. Synthetic TTS audio is clean speech and is NOT a substitute for testing a human voice through a microphone.
